name: hamlib-wasm-monorepo
description: Hamlib compiled to WebAssembly with a Web Serial transport, plus a browser example

scripts.build: npm run build-package && npm run build-example
scripts.typecheck-workspace: tsc -p packages/hamlib-codegen/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/hamlib-wasm/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/hamlib-wasm/tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/hamlib-wasm/native/tsconfig.library.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/basic/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/react/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/harness/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/hooks/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/browser/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/browser/fixtures/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/consumer/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/node/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/hardware/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/node/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck-consumer: rm -rf tests/consumer/packed tests/consumer/node_modules && mkdir -p tests/consumer/packed && npm pack --workspace packages/hamlib-wasm --pack-destination tests/consumer/packed && mv tests/consumer/packed/*.tgz tests/consumer/packed/hamlib-wasm.tgz && npm install --prefix tests/consumer --no-audit --no-fund --no-package-lock
scripts.test: npm run test-hooks && npx playwright test
